agents.primary_role: Accept user corrections, record scope and references, dispatch work, report verified publication.

ownership.workers: Edit and locally commit only their assigned task branch in their assigned worktree. Never change remote main or shared reference files.
ownership.integrator: Own queue, serialized review and merges, reproducible builds, generated outputs, remote main publication and live verification.
ownership.primary: Own user communication and task priorities; do not edit files while a worker owns an overlapping task.

integration_contract: Give each correction an ID and an explicit target screen/state, acceptance criteria and reference.
Fetch and inspect remote main before starting a task and again before publishing.
Serialize integrations; never resolve conflicts by blindly discarding one side.
Review actual diff and test the requested behavior plus relevant regressions.
Regenerate the site and archive from merged source; do not merge separately generated data bundles blindly.
Push only fast-forward updates; never force-push or overwrite an unexpected remote revision.
Preserve user data, palette, accepted decisions and unrelated changes.
Treat newer contradictory user instructions as a scope revision; suppress obsolete publications.
Mark a task published only after GitHub Pages reports built and deployed assets match the intended revision.
Do not claim visual verification from DOM tests. If browser policy blocks viewing, report that limit and do not bypass the block.

first_queued_task.request: Fix visibly unequal spacing between title and actual icon artwork in online and offline states.
first_queued_task.note: Previous container-based attempts were rejected. Windows browser inspection was blocked because the helper could not determine the browser URL. No new fix has been implemented since that stop.

verification.browserVisual: Not performed; existing Computer Use block respected.
verification.fallback: On narrow viewports or large fonts actions can wrap instead of overlapping.

directory_approval: Explicit user approval received 2026-11-05 for the three exact paths and their stated clone/worktree purposes.
